page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head with page number at top. No margin notes. Below the text: a centred heading "Ad Quaest. octavam." and an italic question, ending with a catchword at the right.

main_text.p: rint invitis & dolentibus Ecclesiasti-cis dubium non est vel ex iis verbis Hieronymi; Nam mali dolent ob co-hibitam malitiam; boni ob scandalum datum & ob notam aspersam ministerio per malas aliorum actiones. Quas quidem in causa fuisse tot legum ab Impp. latarum citca personas Ecclesiasticas, recte observat Parœus Comment. Rom. c. 13. p. 1097 ex Novell. 137. ubi Imperator præfatur se cogi ad leges ferendas de Ordinatione Episcoporum & Clericorum per varias querimonias, quæ ad se deferrentur contra eos, ut qui secundum canones divinos minime viverent, adeo ut etiam flagitiosè rudes essent.
Confirmationem hujus propositionis & responsionis ad Argumenta Bellarm. vide apud citatos Theologos.
main_text.head: Ad Quæst. octavam.

p.i: An Magistratus potestatem illam exercere potest, etiam ineonsulta & invita Ecclesia, & quidem

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with italics for Hieronymi, Parœus, Bellarm. and the question passages. Catchword "quidem" is printed at the right below the last line. Printed spellings kept as they stand: "citca", "ineonsulta", "Impp. latarum" (the printed line is hard to read at the join; "latarum" read as printed). "Parœus" read from its ligature, the ligature may be slightly uncertain.
